entities.summary: Katharina Galor is a German-born Israeli art historian and archaeologist specializing in Israel-Palestine. She has been teaching at Brown University since 1998, where she is Hirschfeld Visiting associate professor of Judaic Studies and Visiting associate professor of Urban Studies.
